This '''space station''', used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]], was a [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] located in a low [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]]. The skyhook consisted of a station section with docking hangars and a space elevator shaft. The shaft would deliver beings to and from the underground caverns of the planet in order to avoid exposure to the intense [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] pressure of Quarzite, and was presumably operated by the planet's government under Blank.
